note: A first draft for a code-review system, with the mistakes a model actually makes: a skill id used twice, an agent pointing at a skill that was never written, and a rule with no guidance.

answers.name: PR Review Crew
answers.description: Reviews pull requests in a .NET codebase and blocks merges that are not verified.

agents.name: Reviewer
responsibilities: Read the diff and report what is wrong with it
agents.body: You review pull requests. You do not approve what you have not read.

agents.name: Verifier
responsibilities: Run the build and the tests and report the output
agents.body: You run things and report what happened, never what you expect to happen.

skills.name: Reading a diff
skills.whenToUse: When a pull request has to be reviewed.
skills.body: Read the diff hunk by hunk. Name the file and line for every comment.

skills.name: Reading a large diff
skills.whenToUse: When the diff is larger than 500 lines.
skills.body: Review by file, largest first, and say which files you did not read.

workflows.name: Review a pull request
workflows.body: The reviewer reads the diff, then the change is verified before it is approved.

ironLaws.name: Never approve what was not verified
ironLaws.rule: Never approve a pull request without reading its diff and observing the test output.
ironLaws.rationale: An approval is a claim, and an unverified claim is worse than no review.
